However, overhead resistance remains stiff as the 10-year Treasury yield stays anchored above 5.17%, keeping broader index gains disciplined and range-bound.
technicalsNarrative: Both SPY and QQQ sit in FAIR entry risk zones following a 3-day pause that cooled overbought momentum readings down to RSI 58-60. DIA is testing its 21-EMA with a flattening-to-bearish MACD histogram, making broad index chasing unappealing. Focus entries strictly on individual leading names tightening near structural pivots rather than index beta.
